column1: # The do-unit registry-replay class (found by the variation sweep,
# 2026-07-13; fixed to a SOUND REFUSAL the same day). Was: a compiled
# `do [...]` body containing a registry-mutating statement replayed it
# against the check pass's surviving state (typed defs raised a
# type-conflict Error; check-time registrations were invisible). Now: the
# bake decision refuses a body carrying a capitalised def
# (eng bodyHasReplayHazard) so the interpreter owns these rows with full
# parity, and the import half compiles natively as a closure unit after the
# ensureExportsBound namespace re-bind fix. Value defs (`do [def b 5 …]`)
# were never affected. Full graduation = the Phase 6 JIT detached-unit
# cache compiles these bodies as units, at which point the rows compile
# natively and their ledger entries delete.
# GRADUATED 2026-07-14 (do-def leak fidelity): both typed-def rows compile
# natively as closure units and moved to lang/spec/bytecode-migrated.tsv.
# ── Added 2026-08-28. The two refusal buckets stampFnConst's container
#    descent introduced (varyRefusalLedger names them "dynamic-scope def
#    `files` of unpromoted computed value" and "module binding files rebound
#    after a stored handler captured it as a dep"). Both are the SAME leak:
#    compileStoredFnUnit runs its analysis against the LIVE emit state, so
#    the ENCLOSING compile inherits dep records and dynamic-scope promotion
#    decisions from a body it may never apply. Diagnostics are already
#    restored (TruncateDiagnostics); these are not.
#    They are ledgered rather than avoided because the alternative is worse:
#    without the descent the `for`-wrapped seed MISCOMPILES — a flex map
#    captured by a mount handler loses its identity across loop iterations,
#    and the compiled run raises `expected a FlexMap, got FlexMap` where the
#    interpreter round-trips. That was pinned in varyKnownMiscompiles from
#    2026-07-30 and is now graduated.
#    Graduation for both rows: make the stamp leave the enclosing emit state
#    exactly as it found it — the snapshot/restore shape the diagnostics have,
#    extended over dep records and promotion decisions.

if true [import "boru:io"  def files (flex {})  IO.mount {read: (p:Pathon => [files get `${p}`]) write: ([p:Pathon data:Any] => [files set `${p}` data drop])}  IO.write (make Pathon "n/a.txt") "hello mounted" drop  IO.read (make Pathon "n/a.txt")] [0]
